description: This file declares the DeviceRegistry class, which manages device registration, unregistration, retrieval, and listing of device IDs within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes methods for handling device handlers via smart pointers and maintains a map of device IDs to device handler weak pointers.

classes.name: DeviceRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration, unregistration, and retrieval of device handlers, and maintains a collection of devices.

methods.name: RegisterDevice
methods.description: Registers a device with a given ID and device handler.

methods.name: UnRegisterDevice
methods.description: Unregisters a device by its ID.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the device handler associated with a given device ID.

methods.name: ListDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered device IDs.
